Analysis of growth curve outputs. -Combined Analysis of July 2 and July 20 Data

Saaz and Alyssah

2026-09-15

Dose-response curves for IC50 calculation adapted from Babrham Bioinformatics tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yZRvzYsWqJw Made after “Combined_outputs_analysis_June15”. As a result, outlier batch J9 is already removed. Changes made to input file (addition of replicates column) to accommodate dose-response code. NOTE - APR 2025 - figures modified to only look at control strains.

This code deals with each CNV strain, one at a time.

All_growthcurve_output=All_growthcurve_output[All_growthcurve_output$Media!="SCGlu",]

To follow the tutorial mentioned above, this will be calculated for each CNV strain vs all control strains. That must be done by for loop. But the result of one strain will be shown individually here.

Initial setup data for use in IC50 calculation: 1. Combine all controls from all batches (based on “Combined_outputs_analysis_June15” showing similarity across batches). 2. Create new variable including replicate 3. Plot the data (each replicate visible)

Mod_growthcurve_output=All_growthcurve_output[All_growthcurve_output$Media=="YPD",]

Pilot_output=All_growthcurve_output[All_growthcurve_output$Media==paste(Pilot_media),]

Mod_growthcurve_output=rbind(Mod_growthcurve_output,Pilot_output)

Mod_growthcurve_output$Newsample=paste(Mod_growthcurve_output$Media,"_",Mod_growthcurve_output$Bio_rep,"_",Mod_growthcurve_output$Tech_rep)

ggplot(Mod_growthcurve_output,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=auc_l, group=Newsample, colour=Media)) + geom_line() + geom_point() + theme_bw() + ggtitle(paste("Raw data ", Pilot_media, " vs All Controls"))

ggplot(Mod_growthcurve_output,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=auc_l, group=Newsample, colour=Media)) + geom_line() + geom_point() + theme_bw() + scale_x_log10() + ggtitle(paste("Raw data ", Pilot_media, " vs All Controls - log scale"))

Find mean growth rate for each type (CNV or control) in each FLC conc, and then find the max of these. Normalise all rates by the relevant max (for control and CNV separately). Tidy and plot normalised data.

Mod_growthcurve_output %>%
  group_by(FLC_conc,Media) %>%
  summarise(
    max_response=mean(auc_l)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(max_response)) %>%
  group_by(Media) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  dplyr::select(-FLC_conc) -> max_rates
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by FLC_conc and Media.
## ℹ Output is grouped by FLC_conc.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(FLC_conc, Media))` for per-operation grouping
##   (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
max_rates
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   Media max_response
##   <chr>        <dbl>
## 1 YPD           94.8
## 2 YPGly         20.3
Mod_growthcurve_output %>%
  left_join(max_rates) %>%
  mutate(
    norm_auc=100*auc_l/max_response
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(FLC_conc,Media,Newsample,auc_l,norm_auc) -> drc_norm
## Joining with `by = join_by(Media)`
drc_norm
## # A tibble: 54 × 5
##    FLC_conc Media Newsample   auc_l norm_auc
##       <dbl> <chr> <chr>       <dbl>    <dbl>

##  5        8 YPD   YPD _ 1 _ 1  94.9    100. 
##  6        8 YPD   YPD _ 2 _ 1  92.8     97.8
##  7       16 YPD   YPD _ 1 _ 1  89.2     94.1
##  8       16 YPD   YPD _ 2 _ 1  87.5     92.3
##  9       32 YPD   YPD _ 1 _ 1  76.3     80.5
## 10       32 YPD   YPD _ 2 _ 1  70.4     74.3
## # ℹ 44 more rows
ggplot(drc_norm,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=norm_auc, group=Newsample, colour=Media)) + geom_line() + geom_point() + theme_bw() + scale_x_log10() + ggtitle(paste("Normalised growth rate ", Pilot_media, " vs All Controls - log scale"))

adding error bar to mean data, and plotting it

drc_norm %>%
  group_by(FLC_conc,Media) %>%
  summarise(
    sem = sd(norm_auc)/sqrt(n()),
    response=mean(norm_auc)
  ) -> drc_per_condition
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by FLC_conc and Media.
## ℹ Output is grouped by FLC_conc.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(FLC_conc, Media))` for per-operation grouping
##   (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
drc_per_condition

## # Groups:   FLC_conc [6]

##       <dbl> <chr> <dbl>    <dbl>

## 10       32 YPGly 4.24      52.4

ggplot(drc_per_condition,aes(x=FLC_conc, y=response, ymin=response-sem, ymax=response+sem, colour=Media)) + geom_line() + geom_point() +  geom_errorbar(width=0.1) + theme_bw() + scale_x_log10() + ggtitle(paste("Normalised mean data ", Pilot_media, " vs controls - log scale"))

Fitting to IC50 curve.

drm (
  data = drc_per_condition,
  formula = response ~ FLC_conc,
  curveid = Media,
  fct = LL.4(names=c("Hill slope","Min", "Max","EC50"))
) -> model

tidy(model)
## # A tibble: 8 × 6
##   term       curve estimate std.error statistic      p.value
##   <chr>      <chr>    <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>        <dbl>
## 1 Hill slope YPD       2.00     0.275     7.29  0.00188     
## 2 Hill slope YPGly     3.37     0.512     6.58  0.00276     
## 3 Min        YPD    -484.     854.       -0.567 0.601       
## 4 Min        YPGly    51.6      1.04     49.5   0.00000100  
## 5 Max        YPD     100.       0.898   111.    0.0000000390
## 6 Max        YPGly    98.9      1.33     74.2   0.000000198 
## 7 EC50       YPD     158.     152.        1.04  0.358       
## 8 EC50       YPGly     8.50     0.354    24.0   0.0000179
compParm(model, "EC50", "-")
## 
## Comparison of parameter 'EC50' 
## 
##           Estimate Std. Error t-value p-value
## YPD-YPGly   149.33     152.08  0.9819  0.3817

Showing model fit

dose=c(0,4,8,16,32,64,0,4,8,16,32,64)
condition=c("YPD","YPD","YPD","YPD","YPD","YPD","YPGLy","YPGLy","YPGLy","YPGLy","YPGLy","YPGLy")
predicted_data = data.frame(
  FLC_conc = dose, Type = condition
)

predict(model,newdata=predicted_data) -> predicted_data$prediction

drc_per_condition %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=FLC_conc,y=response,colour=Media)) + geom_point() + scale_x_log10() + theme_bw() + geom_line(data=predicted_data,aes(x=FLC_conc,y=prediction,colour=Type))
## Warning in scale_x_log10(): log-10 transformation introduced infinite values.
## log-10 transformation introduced infinite values.
